title: Students protest in Turbat over shooting of female students

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against the shooting of three female students at Girls Degree College Nushki and worsening security.
tea.want: They demanded justice for the victims, accountability for the attackers, and improved safety for the academic community.
tea.changed: Nov 1: Students and members of the Baloch Students Action Committee staged a demonstration at the University of Turbat.

summary: Students and members of the Baloch Students Action Committee staged a demonstration at the University of Turbat on November 1 to condemn the shooting of three female students at Girls Degree College Nushki. The attack took place on October 27 when unidentified masked gunmen reportedly opened fire inside the college premises, injuring three students, one of whom was transferred to Quetta for specialized medical care due to the severity of her injuries. Demonstrators carried placards denouncing the armed assault, raised concerns over the growing threats faced by the academic community in the region, and called for accountability and student safety.
demands: Enhanced safety for students and the academic community
response: No official response reported in the sources.

injuries.text: Three female students sustained injuries in the attack

updates.text: Three female students were injured in a shooting by unidentified masked gunmen at Girls Degree College Nushki.
The Baloch Students Action Committee organized a protest at the University of Turbat condemning the shooting.
